_comment: Everything environment- or scope-specific lives here. See references/extending.md before changing it.

custom_setting.label: Dynamic Approval Process
custom_setting._comment: The two Setup pages take DIFFERENT identifiers and are not interchangeable. viewCustomSettings wants the object id; listCustomSettingsData wants the key prefix. Passing the object id to the list page renders 'Invalid Custom Setting id'.

limits._comment: Max seconds allowed between a report's screenshot and its CSV export. The screenshot is the evidence that Results is what the report actually showed, so the two must describe the same moment.
